name: Stanton Meats
residence: Sublette County (2026 general candidate listing, Boulder; the same listing marks him withdrawn)
background: Stanton Meats of Sublette County won the August 2026 Democratic primary for county commissioner. The official 2026 general election candidate listing marks him withdrawn, and he does not appear on the official November 2026 general results for the two commissioner seats. No public-record occupation, education, or military service was found in the official pages and other public records reviewed for this Profile.
